The '''soundtrack''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' episodes "[[Chapter 17: The Apostate]]," "[[Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore]]," "[[Chapter 19: The Convert]]," and "[[Chapter 20: The Foundling]]" was released digitally on [[March 29]], [[2023]]. It was composed by [[Joseph Shirley]] and [[Ludwig Göransson]].<ref name="Apple Music" />
